title: Two Young Brothers Playing on Tricycle in Yard, 1950s B&W Deckle Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century outdoor snapshot featuring two young brothers playing outside in a grassy yard. The older boy smiles widely while sitting on his small metal tricycle, wearing a jacket over a striped shirt and shorts. Standing next to him is a younger blond toddler in a buttoned cardigan and trousers, sporting an adorably serious expression. In the background, a mature tree, road, and residential houses complete this classic mid-20th-century slice of suburban or rural childhood life. The photo features decorative deckled edges.
